The '''Y7-O1 Astromech Droid''' was a model of [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] that was used at the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]] near the end of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Y7-O1 Astromech Droids appear as enemies in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', where they can be found in the Administrative Center of the Balmorran Arms Factory on the Imperial version of Balmorra.<ref name="TOR" />
